title: The Mesa Survey
summary: The Guild's master map is fifteen years stale and Kest holds the contract to fix it: three sightline stations, re-shot clean — the dune overlook, the Windspine ridge crest, and the Hollow's crater rim. Hold dead steady at each for a three-count scan. Steady-rider rates apply: the less your bike complains, the plumper the pouch.

objectives.label: Hold station at the dune overlook for the scan
Hold station at the ridge crest — mind the turbine wash
Hold station on the crater rim; do not wave at the listeners
File the triangulation at Kest's survey table

offer.text: Contract, Guild desk, mesa survey. Three sightline stations: dune overlook, ridge crest, crater rim. Hold each one three seconds dead steady — my instruments hate vibration worse than I do, and you'll get along with both of us.
Guild's paying steady-rider rates, Varga — the smoother the hover, the plumper the pouch. It is the only job on this board graded on boredom. Revel in it. Boredom is underpriced.
So: fly very fast to three beautiful places, then stand absolutely still in them. The cruelty of this profession knows no floor.

accept.text: Scrip rings are flagged at each station. Park inside, kill the throttle noise, hold the count. The overlook shots calibrate the ridge; the ridge calibrates the rim. Skimp the first and the map lies about everything east of here forever, *at scale*.
Ketch. Steady-hover work means the landings are the exam — a hard bump restarts the scan clock. Glide in like you're delivering soup. Which, professionally, you are: soup for surveyors.

complete.text: Readings in. Cleanest set I've bought all year. The rim shot bisects the Hollow *exactly* on the old line — the crater hasn't moved, forty years of cartography was right about one thing, and the Guild's map stops lying at the mesa. You're part of a map now, courier. More immortality than most of us get.

The Guild's filed it 'survey, mesa, satisfactory'. Their vocabulary is a dry well. Mine says: rider-shaped accuracy, paid in full, and the mapmakers asked for you by name next season. Guard the secret that you're secretly thrilled.
